index_proof.finite_extension_lemma: For finite L/K0 of degree prime to 3, defectlessness gives [L:K0]=e*f, so e and f are prime to 3; -s cannot become a cube in the residue field because that would embed its Eisenstein cubic extension and force 3|f.
index_proof.binary_valuation: Without residue cancellation, v(x^3+s*y^3) is 0 modulo 3.
index_proof.third_term_valuation: v(t*z^3) is e modulo 3, hence nonzero modulo 3.
index_proof.conclusion: No point exists over a finite extension of degree prime to 3; the displayed degree-three point makes the index exactly 3.

scope: This refutes the formal plane-section principle only; it is not a point of the actual Klein F14_T.
